system: ALPAR AI — Trust Infrastructure for AI Accountability
producer_policy: PRODUCER NEVER SCORES — Auditor holds seal authority

live_probe.diagnosis: Origin web server unreachable from Cloudflare Edge. Cloudflare reverse proxy is active, but origin listener (Coolify / DeHost container or host port) returned 502 / refused connection.

methodology_updates.marquee_overflow_rule: Intentional infinite marquee animation tracks (.animate-marquee-track.flex) have bounding client rects extending beyond window.innerWidth by design. The outer container applies overflow: hidden / clip, ensuring document.documentElement.scrollWidth === window.innerWidth and scrollLeft === 0. This intentional UI animation track is classified as INTENTIONAL_VISUAL_TRACK and isolated from genuine horizontal page layout overflow.
methodology_updates.route_inventory_count: Exact page count: 132 total page.tsx files across repository (1 root page at src/app/page.tsx + 131 localized pages in src/app/[locale]/**/page.tsx).

defects.title: Live 502 Bad Gateway on www.alparai.com /en and /tr
defects.evidence: Probe to https://www.alparai.com/en returned HTTP 502 with CF-Ray a3c2e14f6d37b644-IST and plain text body 'error code: 502'.
defects.impact: Production site is completely unavailable to public users, crawlers, and external API clients.
defects.remediation: Investigate origin web server container status on Coolify / host runner; verify Next.js port binding and upstream health.

defects.title: Dual Content-Security-Policy definition with unsafe-inline
defects.evidence: CSP defined in next.config.mjs as static headers and concurrently in src/middleware.ts dynamically, causing duplicate headers and conflicting policy enforcement.
defects.impact: Unpredictable script blocking in modern browsers and vulnerability to XSS due to loose CSP fallback.
defects.remediation: Removed static CSP from next.config.mjs; unified CSP into src/middleware.ts as single source of truth with strict /embed scoping.

defects.title: Silent API key rotation without revocation timestamp or history trail
defects.evidence: saveApiKey performed direct upsert on provider column without checking prior active key or recording revoked_at in audit logs.
defects.impact: Failure in SOC2/ISO audit trails; previous holders have keys revoked with zero audit trail or timestamps.
defects.remediation: Added pre-rotation query and audit_log insertion with action API_KEY_ROTATED_REVOCATION, revoked_at timestamp, and prior metadata.

defects.title: Documentation version drift (Next.js 15 vs 16.3.3)
defects.evidence: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md referenced Next.js 15 (DeHost / self-hosted) while package.json pins Next.js 16.3.3 and React 19.2.8.
defects.impact: Architectural ambiguity, developer misalignment, and incorrect assumption of runtime behavior.
defects.remediation: Updated docs/ARCHITECTURE.md to reflect Next.js 16.3.3 and React 19.2.8.

defects.title: Forbidden vendor SDK import in quantum hook
defects.evidence: src/hooks/quantum/use-quantum-link.ts imported type RealtimeChannel from @supabase/supabase-js which is not installed, causing TS2307 failure.
defects.impact: Breaks sovereign DeHost backend law and causes pnpm typecheck build failure.
defects.remediation: Removed vendor SDK import, defined local SovereignRealtimeChannel interface, and updated DeHostAdapterClient.

defects.title: ArrayBuffer type mismatch and unchecked indexing in binary codec
defects.evidence: ArrayBufferLike passed to ArrayBuffer parameter; bytes[i] had potential undefined under noUncheckedIndexedAccess.
defects.remediation: Applied typed ArrayBuffer slicing and index nullish coalescing (bytes[i] ?? 0).

defects.title: Duplicate domain in middleware frame-ancestors directive
defects.impact: Redundant CSP header bytes and formatting inconsistency.
defects.remediation: Removed duplicate domain entry from src/middleware.ts.

defects.title: Legacy route aliases lacking centralized next.config edge redirects
defects.evidence: Component-level redirects used instead of edge-level config redirects, adding runtime hop latency.
defects.impact: Unnecessary server component rendering for legacy routes before permanent redirect.
defects.remediation: Centralized all legacy route aliases (case/001, incidents/case-001, about/advisory_board, advisory_board) in next.config.mjs redirects() with 308 permanent redirects.

defects.title: Single CPU build constraint and disabled parallel compiles
defects.evidence: next.config.mjs configures experimental cpus: 1, parallelServerCompiles: false, webpackBuildWorker: false.
defects.impact: Significantly increases build duration on multi-core runner environments.
defects.remediation: Conditionally configure multi-core compilation based on process.env.CI and available os.cpus().

defects.title: Marquee track false-positive overflow categorization in automated scanner
defects.evidence: 40 elements under .animate-marquee-track tagged as visual overflow despite parent overflow-hidden.
defects.impact: Methodology skew and false audit alarm.
defects.remediation: Formalized DOM auditor filter to verify computed overflow style and document-level scrollWidth.

defects.title: Staging DB verification required on fresh migration roundtrip
defects.evidence: WO-010 resolved 10 defect classes; continuous regression test needed on fresh PG 16 container.
defects.impact: Schema drift risk on new table definitions.
defects.remediation: Verified via WO-010 and AUDIT_SEAL_1000: 0001_full_schema.sql and 0002_rls_policies.sql applied to fresh PG 16.15 scratch container with ON_ERROR_STOP=1; exit code 0, 141 tables, 360 policies, 0 residual rows.

defects.title: Disaster Recovery drill evidence freshness
defects.evidence: Last documented DR drill dated 2026-09-06 (RTO 8m 42s); requires scheduled periodic execution proof.
defects.impact: Audit compliance finding if drill interval exceeds 30 days.
defects.remediation: Schedule automated monthly backup restore drill in GitHub Actions scheduled-crons.
